\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Word RAM decider yields polynomial-time class bound]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_DTIME_of_decides}
\label{WordRAM.mem_DTIME_of_decides}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.DTIME, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.WordSizeComputable, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended word RAM program and $L$ a language of Boolean strings. Suppose
there are natural-number-valued functions $W,TW,SW$ such that $W$ is computable by a
finite Turing machine within time $TW(n)$ and space $SW(n)$, and for every Boolean
string $x$ there is an output string $o$ for which $P$, on $x$ with empty coin sequence
and word width $W(|x|)$, halts within $T(|x|)$ steps and space $F(|x|)$, returning the
Boolean indicator of membership in $L$. If $T':\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and
$a\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy, for every $n$, $TW(n)+(T(n)+1)(F(n)(W(n)+1)+W(n)^2+n+1)\le
aT'(n)$, then $L$ belongs to the deterministic time class with bound $T'$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial time for Word RAM decision]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_P_of_decides}
\label{WordRAM.mem_P_of_decides}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.P, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.WordSizeComputable, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program and $L$ a language of Boolean strings. Suppose
functions $W,T_W,S_W:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ are such that a finite Turing machine
computes $W(n)$ in at most $T_W(n)$ steps and uses at most $S_W(n)$ space. Let
$C,d\in\mathbb{N}$, and suppose $T_W(n)+W(n)\le C(n+1)^d$ for every $n$. Suppose also
that for every input $x$ there are natural numbers $t,f$ and an output string $o$ with
$t\le C(|x|+1)^d$, such that $P$ halts within $t$ steps at word width $W(|x|)$, outputs
the Boolean indicator of membership of $x$ in $L$, and uses at most $f$ touched
addresses. Then $L$ belongs to polynomial time, that is,
$L\in\bigcup_{r\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{DTIME}(n^r+1)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Polynomial time from logarithmic word computation]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_P_of_decides_logWord}
\label{WordRAM.mem_P_of_decides_logWord}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.P, Complexity.logSpace, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and
let $c,C,d\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every input $x$ there are natural numbers
$t,f$ and an output string $o$ such that $t\le C(|x|+1)^d$ and $P$ halts within $t$
steps using words of width $c(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$, with output equal to the
Boolean indicator of whether $x\in L$. Then $L$ belongs to polynomial time, that is,
$L\in\bigcup_{r\in\mathbb{N}}\mathrm{DTIME}(n^r+1)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Space bound for Word RAM decisions]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_SPACE_of_decides}
\label{WordRAM.mem_SPACE_of_decides}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.SPACE, Complexity.logSpace, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.WordSizeComputable, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program, $L$ a language of Boolean strings, and
$W,T_W,S_W,F:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose a finite Turing machine computes $W(n)$
in at most $T_W(n)$ steps and space $S_W(n)$. Suppose that for every input $x$ there are
a time bound $t$ and an output string $o$ such that $P$ halts within $t$ steps at word
width $W(|x|)$, outputs the Boolean indicator of membership of $x$ in $L$, and touches
at most $F(|x|)$ addresses. If for some natural number $a$ and function
$s:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, every $n$ satisfies
$S_W(n)+F(n)(W(n)+1)+W(n)+(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)+1\le a s(n)$, then $L$ belongs to
space $s$, that is, $L\in\mathrm{SPACE}(s)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Logarithmic-space class membership]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_LOGSPACE_of_decides}
\label{WordRAM.mem_LOGSPACE_of_decides}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LOGSPACE, Complexity.logSpace, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended word RAM program, $L$ a language of Boolean strings, and $c,F_0$
natural numbers. Suppose that for every Boolean string $x$ there are a natural number
$t$ and output string $o$ such that $P$, on $x$ with empty coin sequence and word width
$c(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$, halts within $t$ steps and space $F_0$, returning the
Boolean indicator of membership in $L$. Then $L$ belongs to logarithmic space.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Space Simulation by a Turing Machine]
\lean{WordRAM.computesInSpace_of_computes}
\label{WordRAM.computesInSpace_of_computes}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.logSpace, Turing.FinTM, Turing.FinTM.ComputesInSpace, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended word-RAM program, let $g$ map Boolean lists to Boolean lists, and
let $c,F_0\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every Boolean input list $x$, there are a
time bound $t$ and a Boolean value $v$ such that $P$, started with word width
$c(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$ and no random bits, halts in fewer than $t$ steps,
outputs $g(x)$, and touches at most $F_0$ memory addresses. Then there are a
finite-state Turing machine $M$ and $a\in\mathbb{N}$ such that, for every Boolean input
$x$, $M$ halts with output $g(x)$ and uses at most $a(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$
work-tape cells.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Quadratic space bound for Word RAM decisions]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_SPACE_mul_of_decides}
\label{WordRAM.mem_SPACE_mul_of_decides}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.SPACE, Complexity.SpaceConstructible, Turing.MultiTapeTM.indicator, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program, $L$ a language of Boolean strings, and
$S:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ a space-constructible function: $S(n)$ is at least
$\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$, and some finite Turing machine outputs the binary
representation of $S(|x|)$ using at most $cS(|x|)$ space for some positive natural
number $c$. Suppose that for every input $x$ there are a time bound $t$ and an output
string $o$ such that $P$ halts within $t$ steps at word width $cS(|x|)$, outputs the
membership indicator of $x$ in $L$, and touches at most $cS(|x|)$ addresses. Then $L$
belongs to space $S(n)^2$, that is, $L\in\mathrm{SPACE}(n\mapsto S(n)S(n))$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Word RAM acceptance implies nondeterministic space membership]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_NSPACE_of_accepts}
\label{WordRAM.mem_NSPACE_of_accepts}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NSPACE, Complexity.logSpace, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.WordSizeComputable, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and
let $W,T_W,S_W,F:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose a finite Turing machine computes the
word width $W(n)$ in at most $T_W(n)$ steps and space $S_W(n)$. Suppose that for every
input $x$ there is a time bound $t$ such that, for every coin string, $P$ halts within
$t$ steps using words of width $W(|x|)$ and at most $F(|x|)$ touched addresses, and
$x\in L$ exactly when some coin string and output yield acceptance within those bounds.
If, for every $n$, $S_W(n)+F(n)(W(n)+1)+W(n)+(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)+1\le a s(n)$ for
natural numbers $a$ and every $n$, then $L$ belongs to nondeterministic space
$\mathrm{NSPACE}(s)$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Word RAM acceptance implies nondeterministic log space]
\lean{WordRAM.mem_NL_of_accepts}
\label{WordRAM.mem_NL_of_accepts}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.NL, Complexity.logSpace, WordRAM.HaltsWithin, WordRAM.XProgram}
Let $P$ be an extended Word RAM program, let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and
let $c,F_0\in\mathbb{N}$. Suppose that for every input $x$ there is a time bound $t$
such that, for every coin string $\rho$, the program halts within $t$ steps using words
of width $c(\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor+1)$ and at most $F_0$ touched memory addresses,
with some output. Suppose also that $x\in L$ exactly when there are coin and output
strings for which it halts within that time and space bound with acceptance. Then $L$ is
decidable in nondeterministic space $\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
\end{theorem}
